1_Learning_Objective.Title: 🎯 The "Why Are We Learning This?" (Learning Objective)
1_Learning_Objective.Content: The goal is to help your child look closely at scenes, find hidden details, and learn how to describe where things are using position words like 'in', 'on', and 'under'.

2_The_Hook.Title: 🪝 The Hook (How to start the conversation)
2_The_Hook.Content: Sit in the center of a room, cover your eyes, and say: **'I am looking for something red... and it is hiding UNDER something. Can you find it before I count to 10?'** After they find it, say, **'You have great detective eyes! Let's use our detective eyes on the pictures in this chapter.'**

Mini_Lessons.What_To_Say: Tell your child: 'Pictures are full of secrets. Look at this page. I see a bird, a tree, and a dog. Point your magic finger at the bird!'
Mini_Lessons.Home_Example: Open a busy picture in the book. Ask them to find 3 specific things (e.g., 'Find the boy with the hat', 'Find the yellow flower').

Mini_Lessons.Topic: Lesson 2: Where is it? (In, On, Under)
Mini_Lessons.What_To_Say: Tell your child: 'Things like to hide! Sometimes they sit ON top of things, sometimes they hide UNDER things, and sometimes they go IN a box.'
Mini_Lessons.Home_Example: Take their favorite small toy. Put it *on* the table, *under* the chair, and *in* a cup. Ask them each time: 'Where is the toy now?'

Mini_Lessons.What_To_Say: Tell your child: 'Let's find things that start with our favorite letters! What starts with B? Ball! What starts with C? Cat!'
Mini_Lessons.Home_Example: Look around your living room. Ask them to point to something that starts with the 'T' sound (Table, TV) or 'S' sound (Sofa, Shoes).

4_Common_Stumbling_Blocks.Title: 🚧 Common Stumbling Blocks (What to watch out for)
4_Common_Stumbling_Blocks.Content:
Kids often confuse **'in'** and **'on'**. 
*   **How to clarify:** Use your hands. Make a cup with one hand and put your other fist inside it ('This is IN'). Put a flat hand on top of your fist ('This is ON'). Let them practice with their own hands!

Questions.Question: If I put my shoes beneath the bed, are they IN the bed or UNDER the bed?
Look at the table. Is the plate ON the table or IN the table?
Can you spot 3 things in this room that start with the 'B' sound?

Activities.Name: 1. The Household Scavenger Hunt
Activities.Description: Give them a mini-mission. Say, 'Bring me something soft, something shiny, and something blue!' Time them for 1 minute.

Activities.Name: 2. Obstacle Course Instructions
Activities.Description: Set up pillows and chairs. Give them directions using position words: 'Crawl UNDER the table, step ON the pillow, and sit IN the box.'

Activities.Name: 3. Draw What I Say
Activities.Description: Give them paper. Say, 'Draw a tree. Now draw a sun ON top of the tree. Now draw a ball UNDER the tree.' Compare the funny pictures at the end.

Activities.Name: 4. The Cup and Coin Hiding Game
Activities.Description: Take a plastic cup and a coin. Hide the coin IN the cup, ON the cup (upside down), or UNDER the cup. Lift your hand and let them shout out the position word.
